question: Why is the lord of that group praised as Bhairava in the scripture?
premises: He is the lord of that goddess group.
He is greatly terrifying because he shatters worldly activity.
The teachers praise him in the scripture through etymological meanings.
inference: The name Bhairava is affirmed by the teachers as expressing his lordship and his power to break the course of worldly existence.
plain_english: The lord of that group, greatly terrifying because he shatters the activity of worldly existence, is praised in the scripture by the teachers as Bhairava through these etymological meanings.
